summary_en: Introduces PAATAM, a real-time freehand photoacoustic angiography tracking-and-mapping system that estimates six-degree-of-freedom probe motion and fuses geometric and intensity vascular features to build globally consistent 3D panoramic vascular maps. The study reports sub-1% relative tracking error in most tested settings and demonstrates large field-of-view expansion in vivo, making it directly relevant to computational photoacoustic imaging and image-guided intervention.

summary_en: Presents a binary-aperture hologram design based on a multi-frequency optimal accumulation algorithm to encode two ultrasonic frequencies simultaneously. Theory, full-wave simulation, and underwater experiments demonstrate dual-frequency holographic projection with a drilled stainless-steel aperture plate, making the work a direct match for acoustic holography and coded acoustic wavefront imaging.

summary_en: Develops an augmented-reality guidance system that tracks a freehand light source and ultrasound transducer for real-time photoacoustic imaging, reducing the risk of signal loss from optical-acoustic misalignment. The reported static alignment experiments show a 58% reduction in mean targeting error and substantially lower laser-image intersection variance, supporting direct relevance to practical photoacoustic-guided intervention.
